items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know Alex or Manuel Manetta. I didn't know them. ... No, I never knew him.

ctx.x: Oh, sorry. I know what you're talking about. Yes.

And I says, "Yeah." So he says, "I'll pay you five dollars a night." Which was pretty good bread, I'll tell ya! Because I think we was playing for three dollars a day in this thing. So I said, "Sure." So I told my brother Frank, and I said, "Just tell Papa I ain't comin' back." Frank said, "Well, we might have a job..." I said, "To heck with the job, man. You haven't got no job in Baton Rouge gonna pay me any five dollars a night." So that was my start with the Martel band.
Before I got in that band, at one time Manuel Manetta and Barney's brother Alex also had played in that same band.
